syntheticPolicies.clock: performance.now monotonic milliseconds passed as a pure-function parameter
syntheticPolicies.firstAttempt: accepted immediately because the original initialization of LastinnTalk is not defined
syntheticPolicies.interactionGeometry: point actor to center of synthetic INN tile, not original item collision vectors
syntheticPolicies.dialogueText: newly-authored paraphrases, not imported original RPGCode text

guards: no previous talk, or now - LastinnTalk > 500
actions: select first dialogue when checkedInn=0, otherwise repeat dialogue
freeze player movement until dialogue ends
after final line, increment checkedInn, update LastinnTalk
if first and previously unchecked, award one clue up to 13

limitations: does not interpret or execute original RPGCode
does not run COM DLLs or simulate source-authored board/activation vectors
dialogue and first-activation tick semantics are explicit approximations
no save/load persistence; reset clears all variables
